ita-mainbeam.title: 國際隧協敞開與雙護盾掘進原理
ita-mainbeam.titleEn: ITA main-beam and double-shield TBM principles
ita-mainbeam.scope: 協會對反力路徑與掘進循環的公開說明，不是特定設備操作手冊。
ita-mainbeam.scopeEn: Association overview of reaction paths and excavation cycles, not an operating manual for an individual machine.

hk-double.title: 海瑞克雙護盾掘進機產品技術介紹
hk-double.titleEn: Herrenknecht Double Shield TBM technical overview
hk-double.scope: 已由搜尋確認官方頁與伸縮盾構造摘要；直接全文擷取受限，不引用未見的性能數字。
hk-double.scopeEn: Official page and telescopic-shield description confirmed by search; direct full-page retrieval was restricted. No unseen performance figures are cited.

hk-gripper.title: 海瑞克撐靴式掘進機技術介紹
hk-gripper.scope: 已由搜尋確認官方硬岩機型頁；只用作設備類型參考，直接全文擷取受限。
hk-gripper.scopeEn: Official hard-rock machine page confirmed by search; used only as a machine-type reference because direct full-page retrieval was restricted.

fhwa-manual.title: 公路隧道設計施工土建技術手冊
fhwa-manual.titleEn: Technical Manual for Design and Construction of Road Tunnels: Civil Elements
fhwa-manual.scope: 二〇〇九年官方手冊書目；用作隧道土建設計參考來源，未聲稱此舊手冊是現行個案規範。
fhwa-manual.scopeEn: Official 2009 manual record; a civil tunnel design reference, not a claim that an older manual is the current specification for a project.

crossrail-scl.title: Crossrail噴凝土襯砌的設計觀點
crossrail-scl.titleEn: Design of Sprayed Concrete Linings in Soft Ground: A Crossrail Perspective
crossrail-scl.scope: 原作者技術論文，支援施工序列、地層互制與早齡襯砌之背景，算例另列為合成假設。
crossrail-scl.scopeEn: Original authors technical paper supporting construction sequence, ground interaction and early-age lining context. Course calculations are separately identified as synthetic assumptions.

crossrail-stepney.title: Stepney Green洞室襯砌設計與表現
crossrail-stepney.titleEn: Stepney Green Cavern: Design Concepts and Performance of SCL Lining
crossrail-stepney.scope: 原作者公開側壁導坑與襯砌觀測案例；不把案例斷面與步距移植為本課施工處方。
crossrail-stepney.scopeEn: Original authors public side-drift and lining-monitoring case; its dimensions and advances are not transferred into a construction prescription.

swiss-nrla.title: 瑞士新阿爾卑斯鐵路連線官方背景
swiss-nrla.titleEn: Swiss New Rail Link through the Alps: official background
swiss-nrla.scope: 政府對聖哥達基線隧道二〇一六年營運的背景資料；不聲稱每一教學方法都曾在此採用。
swiss-nrla.scopeEn: Government context for Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016; no claim that every taught technique was used there.

limitations: All calculations are original synthetic teaching assumptions, not actual project measurements or machine settings.
Herrenknecht official URLs were search-confirmed; direct fetch was restricted.
FHWA bibliography was verified; its full 32 MB manual was not fetched.
Landmarks supply contrasting contexts, not claims that each method was used at each site.
All securities are null. No securities claim is made.
